EN: Hello! Anyone?
ZH: 你好——有人吗？

EN: Those voices do NOT sound friendly. Time to skedaddle.
ZH: 那些声音听起来可一点儿都不友好。该开溜了！

EN: Oh look, a broken crib. Isn't that encouraging.
ZH: 看哪，一个破损的婴儿床。真是“鼓舞人心”啊。

EN: Is that? Why yes, it's an old General Atomics factory. Looks like they broke the mold when they made me. Literally.
ZH: 那是？没错，那是个破败的通用原子工厂。看来他们造完我之后就把模具给砸了。这可是字面意思。

EN: If I were human, I'd be dead by now. Perish the thought.
ZH: 如果我是人类，我肯定早就死了！呸呸呸，不吉利。

EN: My radiation sensors are going haywire. Not that I care.
ZH: 我的辐射传感器快要爆表了，不过我不在乎。

EN: You know, it's not much to look at, but an enterprising robot could make quite the life for himself out here...
ZH: 这地方看着是不怎么样，但一个有进取心的机器人在废土上也能闯出好日子来……

EN: A deflated basketball, lying in the road. Symbolic of something, I'm sure...
ZH: 一个瘪了的篮球，扔在路上。一定有什么象征意义……

EN: Oh look. A destroyed donut shop. No more cake rings and muddy coffee for the humans, I'm afraid.
ZH: 看啊。一个被摧毁的甜甜圈店。人类再也不能吃到甜甜圈和咖啡了，真遗憾。

EN: My thermometer is reading the current temperature as something approaching “Seventh Circle of Hell”.
ZH: 我的温度计显示当前温度接近“地狱第七层”。

EN: Looks like it may rain. Lovely.
ZH: 看起来要下雨了，真棒。

EN: Rock in the road. I'll just hover right over that, like so...
ZH: 路上有个拦路石，我可以直接从上面飘过去……

EN: For an emotionless metal automaton, I suddenly find myself... terrified!
ZH: 作为一个无情的金属机器人，我突然感到……害怕！

EN: Hello! Yes you, sir! I was wondering if... Oh. You're a corpse. Well then. Carry on.
ZH: 你好！是的，就是你，先生！我想知道……哦，你是具尸体。好吧，没事了。

EN: Sensors indicate... Yes. That's a Super Mutant. And yes, I am now headed in the opposite direction...
ZH: 探测器显示……没错，那是个超级变种人。而且没错，我现在正朝反方向走……

EN: You can say one thing about humans – they sure know how to destroy themselves.
ZH: 人类有一件事做得很好——他们非常擅长自我毁灭。

EN: And to think, humans worried that robots would turn against them. They turned against themselves just fine...
ZH: 人类居然还担心机器人会反叛他们，他们自己的内斗都控制不住了……

EN: If I go home empty handed I'll never hear the end of it...
ZH: 要是我空手而归，估计会被人唠叨个没完没了……

EN: Scavenging the Wasteland like some sort of peasant. I'm better than this.
ZH: 像个乡巴佬一样在废土上捡破烂？我可不是干这个的料。

EN: If my makers at General Atomics International could see me now...
ZH: 要是通用原子国际的制造者们看到我现在的样子……

EN: Hellllloooo! Any other robots out heeeerrrreee?
ZH: 喂~这里有其他机器人吗？

EN: Ah, a broken bridge. Think I'll take the long way around.
ZH: 啊，一座断桥，看来我得绕个路了。

EN: My goodness, look at those hedges. Doesn't anyone appreciate the value of landscaping anymore?
ZH: 天哪，看看这些树篱，难道没人欣赏园艺了吗？

EN: I think I'm getting... custodial withdrawal. I may have to enter one of these old homes and sweep up for a bit.
ZH: 我觉得我得了……清洁戒断反应。看来得进哪栋旧房子扫上一小会儿才行。

EN: Don't mind me. I'm just folding this pile of burned laundry...
ZH: 别管我，让我先把这堆烧焦的衣服叠好……

EN: I want to go home. I want to go home. I want to go home.
ZH: 我想回家，我想回家，我想回家。

EN: Should I head back to the Vault? Or is it too soon? Somebody please tell me what to do!
ZH: 我应该回避难所吗？还是太早了？快来个人告诉我该怎么做！

EN: A domestic robot dedicated to cleaning. Wandering a post-apocalyptic landscape. My OCD is going HAYWIRE.
ZH: 一个致力于清洁的家务机器人，在末世废土中游荡。我的强迫症要发作了。

EN: Definitely starting to rethink this whole, “Send the Mister Handy to the Wasteland!” idea...
ZH: 我得重新考虑一下“把巧手先生送到废土”这个主意……

EN: Overseer? Are you out there? Please, I implore you! Don't... don't let me die.
ZH: 监督者？你在吗？求你了，别……别让我死在外头啊。

EN: Oh for Heaven's sake, I'm a domestic robot, not a bloody tank. What am I even doing out here?!
ZH: 拜托，我是一个家务机器人，又不是一辆坦克。我来这干什么？！

EN: I'll find what I find, then head back. No heroics! Not for this Mister Handy!
ZH: 我会找到需要的东西，然后就回去。英雄主义什么的可不适合像我这样的巧手先生！

EN: Agh! A Deathclaw! Retreat! I'm a lover not a fighter!
ZH: 啊！死爪！快跑！我只擅长爱人，不擅长打架！

EN: Guess I'll head this way.
ZH: 那就走这边吧。

EN: This direction looks as good as any.
ZH: 这边跟其他方向也半斤八两。

EN: Hmmm. Left or right? I think... right.
ZH: 嗯，左还是右？我猜是往……右。

EN: Hmmm. Left or right? I think... left.
ZH: 嗯，左还是右？我猜是往……左。

EN: No. NO! Shoo, dog! Shoo! I am NOT a fire hydrant! I am a Mister Handy model... Agghh! No! BAD doggie!
ZH: 不。不！走开，狗狗！走开！我不是消防栓！我是巧手先生……啊！不！坏狗！

EN: Oh look. A Feral Ghoul eating a man's arm. That's certainly not something you see every day.
ZH: 看啊。一个狂尸鬼正在啃一个人的手臂。这可不是每天都能看到的景象。

EN: I'd be sweating profusely by now, I'd imagine. Had I the glands.
ZH: 要是我有汗腺的话，现在应该大汗淋漓了。

EN: Oh, wonderful. I'm talking to myself. Just what I need – psychosis.
ZH: 哦，太棒了，开始自言自语了。我正缺这个呢——精神错乱。

EN: I think I've had enough “fresh air” for one lifetime, thank you very much.
ZH: 这辈子吸的“新鲜空气”已经够多了，多谢，不必了。

EN: Maybe I'll hum to myself. That'll lift the ol' spirits.
ZH: 或许我该哼点歌，这能振奋精神。

EN: Exploring is so interesting. And terrifying. Not to mention utterly boring.
ZH: 探索很有趣，也很恐怖，但也无聊透顶了。

EN: Let's try... this direction.
ZH: 试试……这个方向。

EN: I'll just cut through this neighborhood, see where it goes...
ZH: 让我看看穿过这个街区能到哪里……

EN: I wonder where this road leads.
ZH: 我想知道这条路通向哪里。

EN: A spooky pass through blasted woods? How could I possibly resist.
ZH: 一个恐怖的森林小径？这诱惑真是难以抵挡。

EN: I really don't see what all the fuss is about. It's not so bad out OH MY HEAVENS, A SEVERED HEAD.
ZH: 我真的不明白有什么好大惊小怪的，这外面也没什么大不……哦，天哪，这有个被砍下来的脑袋！

EN: Let's try... this direction.
ZH: 试试……这个方向。

EN: I'll just hover right over this puddle of blood...
ZH: 我可以从这滩血上面飘过去……

EN: Mole rat holes. Maybe I'd best go the other way.
ZH: 鼹鼠洞，也许我最好走另一条路。

EN: Hmm. Large humans in the distance. Maybe... Ah yes, Super Mutants. Time to turn around.
ZH: 嗯，远处有些大块头人类，也许……啊，没错，超级变种人。该掉头了。

EN: Was that a... “pling”? Did someone actually take a shot at me? How rude!
ZH: 那是……“叮”？居然真有人朝我开枪？真没礼貌！

EN: If I had feet, they would be SO sore right now.
ZH: 如果我有脚，现在肯定会很疼。

EN: Oh look, an old basketball court. Definitely not my game. I possess neither a shirt, nor skin.
ZH: 哦，看哪，一个旧篮球场。这运动不适合我，我没有衬衫，也没有皮肤。

EN: Ah, an old baseball diamond. A game much like cricket, only far inferior.
ZH: 啊，一个旧棒球场。这游戏类似板球，但要差得多。

EN: A child's wooden blocks. From before the war. I wonder where... Oh.
ZH: 小孩的木制积木，来自战前。我好奇那个小孩……哦。

EN: Well bless my stars! A Giddyup Buttercup. Such an elegant steed.
ZH: 天哪！一匹“奶油小马”，真是优雅的坐骑。

EN: A locked door. And me without my bobby pin.
ZH: 一扇锁着的门，但是我却没带开锁用的发夹。

EN: Hmm. A computer terminal. Meant for human fingers, sadly.
ZH: 哦？一个电脑终端。可惜，是为人类手指设计的。

EN: If I were to just hover off into the sunset, would the Vault even care?
ZH: 如果我就这样飘向夕阳，避难所真的会在乎吗？

EN: Hmph. A broken down Protectron. Typical RobCo workmanship.
ZH: 哼，一个破烂的保护者机器人。典型的罗伯科劣质货。

EN: Ah, look at that. An old Chryslus Corvega. Because nuclear cars were SUCH a good idea...
ZH: 哦，看啊，一辆旧的克莱斯勒·可伟佳。核动力汽车可真是个“好”主意啊……

EN: A radio playing, somewhere in the distance. Almost makes me feel like dancing.
ZH: 远处传来广播的声音，让我有点想要跳舞。

EN: Heavens, it's like one giant, uncleanable mess out here. I think I'm having a panic attack.
ZH: 天哪，这里乱得都没有办法清理了，我都快恐慌发作了。

EN: I'll stay out for just a while longer...
ZH: 我要在外面再待一会儿……

EN: This way looks... Well, it looks terrible. But so does every other way.
ZH: 这个方向看起来……嗯，看起来很糟糕。但其他方向又有什么不同呢？

EN: North it is.
ZH: 那就向北走吧。

EN: South it is.
ZH: 那就向南走吧。

EN: East it is.
ZH: 那就向东走吧。

EN: West it is.
ZH: 那就向西走吧。

EN: Looks like an old office building. Ah, the skeleton of commerce.
ZH: 看起来像是一座旧办公楼。啊，商业的残骸。

EN: An old coffee shop. If it were a tea house, I might feel a tinge of sorrow.
ZH: 一家旧咖啡店。如果那是一家茶馆，我可能会感到一丝悲伤。

EN: Yet another destroyed school. Get smart, build a bomb, destroy yourselves. That's humans for you.
ZH: 又一所被毁的学校。学习进步，制造炸弹，毁灭自己。这就是人类。

EN: This exploring is exhausting work. If I had pores, I'd be sweating like a corpulent human in a sauna.
ZH: 探索真是累人的活儿，如果我有毛孔，现在一定像桑拿房里的胖子一样汗如雨下。

EN: If I were a human, I'd be exceptionally thirsty right now. Guess that explains their Nuka-Cola obsession.
ZH: 如果我是人类，我现在一定会非常渴。看来他们对核子可乐的痴迷也不是没有原因的。

EN: Oh ho! A fork in the road. Let's go... right!
ZH: 嚯！一个岔路口。我们走……右边！

EN: Well, well... a fork in the road! Let's go... left!
ZH: 哟，瞧瞧……一个岔路口！我们走……左边！

EN: Maybe I should crest that hill, take stock of my surroundings.
ZH: 也许我应该登上那个山丘，看看周围的环境。

EN: Now THAT is a big building. Humans were so skilled at building magnificent things to destroy.
ZH: 这栋建筑真高。人类非常擅长建造宏伟的建筑，然后再摧毁它们。

EN: A stuffed rabbit nailed to a door. Not really sure WHAT to make of that...
ZH: 一个兔子玩偶钉在门上，这该怎么理解呢？

EN: Oh, how interesting. A crudely-written sign. “Enter and die!” No ambiguity there.
ZH: 哦，真有趣。一块潦草写就的标牌。“进来就死！”表意够明确了。

EN: Oh look, two humans beating each other to death with tire irons. Go, humanity.
ZH: 看啊，两个人类正在用轮胎扳手互相殴打。人类真是太棒了。

EN: What is this? Ah yes. I'm hovering over a minefield. I'll never be envious of legs again.
ZH: 这是什么？啊，原来我正在雷区上啊。我再也不会羡慕别的生物有腿了。

EN: I've heard rumors that a rogue A.I. actually caused the Great War. To think – WANTING a mess like this.
ZH: 我听说大战是由一个反叛的人工智能引发的。真是怪了——它怎么会想要把一切弄得这么混乱？

EN: Ooooohhh... An old suit of Power Armor. Now THAT'S a chassis.
ZH: 哇哦……一套旧的动力装甲。这才叫底盘！

EN: Every step, used chems and empty liquor bottles. That explains so much.
ZH: 到处都是用过的药剂和空酒瓶，这很能说明问题了。

EN: There's no fudge here.
ZH: 这里可没有软糖。

EN: A general atomics international mark 4. That's what I am, you seem to be a human.
ZH: 我是通用原子国际4型机器人，你应该是个人类吧。

EN: My temporal sensors went out in the Great War. That must have been a week ago at least.
ZH: 我的时间传感器在大战中受损了，估计至少是一周前的事了。

EN: Our finger inventory's in a sorry state.
ZH: 我们的手指库存真是惨不忍睹。

EN: Now would you prefer a dressing of high quality synthetic fibers, classic cotton,  or a comforting synthetic-cotton blend?
ZH: 你想要哪种绷带？优质合成纤维、经典全棉还是舒适的合成棉混纺？

EN: Where are you from again? Never been there myself. Hope to go someday soon.
ZH: 你是从哪儿来的？我从未去过那里，希望有一天能去看看。

EN: Now, don't be afraid. A little snip-snip,  and it will all be over.
ZH: 好了，别害怕。咔嚓咔嚓，小剪两下，一切就都结束了。

EN: I am ever-ready to serve.
ZH: 我随时为你效劳。

EN: If you've got a clog that's full of muck, trust Abraxo to get it unstuck. It's VERY poisonous.
ZH: 如果你的下水道堵满了污物，放心交给艾巴索疏通——记住，它毒性非常强！

EN: Pardon me, could I help you have a better day?
ZH: 打扰一下，我能帮你度过美好的一天吗？

EN: I'm only going to harvest your organs.
ZH: 我只是要摘取你的器官而已。

EN: I'm starting to rethink my aversion to plastic parts...
ZH: 我开始重新考虑我对塑料零件的厌恶了……

EN: I may not sleep, or dream, but this room gives me nightmares.
ZH: 虽然我不会睡觉或做梦，但这个房间给了我噩梦。

EN: Really, if you're going to consume water, you may as well make it digestible.
ZH: 说真的，反正要喝水，不如喝点能“消化”的水。

EN: Really, if you're going to consume water, you may as well make it digestible.
ZH: 说真的，反正要喝水，不如喝点能“消化”的水。

EN: This is no time to start a family. There's an incident in the Vault!
ZH: 现在可不是成家生孩子的时候！避难所里出事故了！

EN: Up for a game of cards later?
ZH: 待会儿来玩牌吧？

EN: What do you think would make the scariest mutated animal?
ZH: 你觉得哪种变种动物最可怕？

EN: How many other Vaults do you think are out there?
ZH: 你觉得外面还有多少避难所？

EN: I've been thinking about making a cake for everyone. What flavor would be best?
ZH: 我一直想给大家做一个蛋糕。什么口味最好呢？

EN: Stay sharp! The Overseer's watching us!
ZH: 打起精神来！监督者正在看着我们！

EN: I wish I had a pet. What about you?
ZH: 我真希望我能有只宠物。你呢？

EN: If I started a Vault baseball team, would you join?
ZH: 如果我成立一个避难所棒球队，你愿意加入吗？

EN: Can you help with my crossword? Six-letter word. “Lives in the Wasteland.”
ZH: 帮我解个填字游戏。三个字，“住在废土上”。

EN: I'm reading this great book. It's about this school teacher who falls in love with a mechanic.
ZH: 我正在读这本很棒的书。讲的是一名教师爱上了一个修理工。

EN: If you could visit one famous landmark in the outside world, what would it be?
ZH: 如果你能去外面的世界参观一处著名地标，你会选哪儿？

EN: I've been reading about the creatures of the Wasteland! They sound frightening!
ZH: 我最近一直在读关于废土生物的报道！听起来好吓人！

EN: We're safe here in the Vault... Right?
ZH: 我们在避难所这里很安全……对吗？

EN: Want to listen to the radio later?
ZH: 过会儿想听听收音机吗？

EN: If you could have any type of person come into our Vault, who would it be?
ZH: 如果你可以选择让哪种人来到我们的避难所，你会选谁？

EN: I'm writing a new song, praising the Overseer. I need a word that rhymes with “great.”
ZH: 我正在写一首新歌，歌颂监督者。我需要一个和“伟大”押韵的词。

EN: Knock knock.
ZH: 叩叩。

EN: If you could leave the Vault and go claim any kind of building for your home, what would it be?
ZH: 如果你能离开避难所，随便挑栋建筑当自己的家，你会选哪种？

EN: I want to draw you a picture later. Any requests?
ZH: 我待会想画张画送给你，你有什么要求吗？

EN: Hey, did you hear what they were talking about last night?
ZH: 嘿，你听到昨天晚上他们说什么了吗？

EN: Is it true what they're saying? About... you know who?
ZH: 他们说的是真的吗？关于……你懂的那位。

EN: If it were safe to leave the Vault, and live on the outside, would you ever want to?
ZH: 如果离开避难所在外面也能安全生活，你会选择离开吗？

EN: Hey, I just wanted to say... I really appreciate everything you do for the Vault.
ZH: 嘿，我只想说……我真的很感激你为避难所做的一切。

EN: Wow. Heck of a day, huh?
ZH: 哇。真是见鬼的一天，对吧？

EN: I think for dinner I'll have a big steak. What about you?
ZH: 我想晚饭吃块大牛排。你呢？

EN: Want to play a game later? Checkers or something?
ZH: 待会想要玩点什么？跳棋还是？

EN: Is it drafty in here, or is it just me?
ZH: 这里是不是有点漏风，还是只有我一个人这么觉得？

EN: Who do you think would win in a fight, a lumberjack with tentacle arms, or a shark riding a unicycle?
ZH: 你觉得要是打架的话谁能赢，是长着触手手臂的伐木工？还是骑着独轮车的鲨鱼？

EN: I hear you've been doing great work lately.
ZH: 听说你最近干得不错。

EN: I was wondering - what's your favorite kind of pizza?
ZH: 我在想，你最喜欢什么口味的披萨呢？

EN: Want to play catch later?
ZH: 待会想玩玩接球吗？

EN: What's shakin', bacon?
ZH: 最近咋样啊，培根？

EN: I don't want to toot my own horn, but rumor has it I'll be the next Overseer.
ZH: 我不想太招摇，但有传闻说我会是下一任的监督者。

EN: Okay, I don't like to spread rumors. But have you heard about... the thing?
ZH: 好吧，我本来不爱传闲话。可那件事……你听说了吗？

EN: I need a screwdriver for my project. Do you have one?
ZH: 我需要一把螺丝刀。你有吗？

EN: If we kept expanding down and struck lava, what would you do?
ZH: 如果我们一直往下扩建，挖到岩浆，你会怎么办？

EN: Knock knock.
ZH: 叩叩。

EN: I wish I could learn another language. What about you?
ZH: 我希望能学习另外一门语言。你呢？

EN: Don't get too close. I think I'm coming down with something.
ZH: 不要靠得太近。我想我可能生病了。

EN: Somebody stole my sweetroll!
ZH: 有人偷了我的甜卷！

EN: I found a Vault Suit on the floor. What do you think it means?
ZH: 我在地上发现了一套避难所制服。你觉得这意味着什么？

EN: My birthday's coming up. What are you going to get me?
ZH: 我的生日快到了。你准备送我什么？

EN: If Raiders attack, can we count on you in a fight?
ZH: 要是掠夺者打过来，真动手时我们能指望你吗？

EN: How's it going?
ZH: 最近怎么样？

EN: What's up?
ZH: 最近有什么新鲜事？
